title: CVS Refill Weekly Days Supply Trend
dataSources: GoodRx prices (`goodrx:price`), CVS refills (`cvs:refill`), pharmacy pickups (`pharmacy:pickup`), and prescription adherence logs (`prescription:adherence`).
app: GoodRx price lookups, CVS refill confirmations, pharmacy pickup logs, and prescription adherence trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cvs:refill days_supply=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(days_supply) as avg_duration, max(days_supply) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst days supply for CVS refill events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture days_supply on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average days supply with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It records whether CVS refill tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
